structurePatterns: vertical stack: header (title + optional action) -> body -> footer
outlined variant adds 1px subtle border; default is borderless
interactive variant shows pressed surface on tap, no shadow by default
usageHints: prefer Section grouping before wrapping content in Card
border is optional, only when containment needs reinforcement
do not nest cards inside cards
whole-card action must not compete with multiple equal-priority inner actions
doNotInvent: no default shadow (flat-first; elevation only for floating/modal overlays)
unknowns: header-to-body gap not separately tokenized; uses internalGap 8px
